title: Evolution and identification of DREB transcription factors in the wheat genome: modeling, docking and simulation of DREB proteins associated with salt stress.
authors: Hassan, Sameer; Berk, Katrin; Aronsson, Henrik
one_liner_zh: 该研究在小麦全基因组中鉴定DREB转录因子，并通过同源建模、分子对接和25ns分子动力学模拟分析DREB蛋白与含CCGAC基序DNA的稳定结合及关键互作残基，属于典型的TF-DNA互作机制建模研究。
abstract: Soil salinity and the resulting salt stress it imposes on crop plants is a major problem for modern agriculture. Understanding how salt tolerance mechanisms in plants are regulated is therefore important. One regulatory mechanism is the APETALA2/Ethylene Responsive Factor (AP2/ERF) transcription factor family, including dehydration responsive element binding (DREB) transcription factors. By binding to DNA, specifically upstream of genes that play roles in salt tolerance pathways, DREB proteins upregulate expression of these genes. DREB in Triticum aestivum (wheat) cluster in sub-groups and in this study by scanning the recently extended predicted proteome of wheat for DREB, we increased the number of members of this sub-family. Using the wheat genome, we identified 576 genes coding for the AP2 domain of which 508 were identified to have one AP2 domain, a characteristic of the DREB/ERF subfamily. We confirmed the existing four sub-groups by sequence-based phylogenetic analyses but also identified 32 new DREB subfamily members, not belonging to any known sub-group. Transcription factor profile inference analysis identified two genes, TraesCS2B02G002700 and TraesCS2D02G015200, being homologous to DREB1A of Arabidopsis thaliana. Based on molecular simulation (25 ns) analysis, TraesCS2B02G002700 with a CCGAC motif was observed to interact very stably with DNA. In silico mutational analysis at the 19(th) position in the DREB domain of TraesCS2B02G002700-DNA complex indicated this as a stable part for recognizing and forming interaction with DNA. Moreover, six target genes were predicted having an upstream CCGAC motif regulated by TraesCS2B02G002700. Our study provides an overall framework for exploring the transcription factors in plants and identifying e.g. potential salt stress target genes.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 土壤盐分及其对作物植物造成的盐胁迫是现代农业面临的一个主要问题。因此，理解植物耐盐机制的调控方式至关重要。一种调控机制是APETALA2/乙烯响应因子（AP2/ERF）转录因子家族，包括脱水响应元件结合（DREB）转录因子。通过结合DNA，特别是盐耐受途径中起作用的基因上游区域，DREB蛋白上调这些基因的表达。小麦（Triticum aestivum）中的DREB蛋白聚集在亚组中，本研究通过扫描最近扩展的小麦预测蛋白质组以寻找DREB，增加了该亚家族的成员数量。利用小麦基因组，我们鉴定了576个编码AP2结构域的基因，其中508个被鉴定为含有一个AP2结构域，这是DREB/ERF亚家族的特征。我们通过基于序列的系统发育分析确认了现有的四个亚组，但也鉴定了32个新的DREB亚家族成员，它们不属于任何已知亚组。转录因子谱推断分析鉴定了两个基因，TraesCS2B02G002700和TraesCS2D02G015200，与拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）的DREB1A同源。基于分子模拟（25 ns）分析，带有CCGAC基序的TraesCS2B02G002700被观察到与DNA非常稳定地相互作用。对TraesCS2B02G002700-DNA复合物中DREB结构域第19位点的计算机模拟突变分析表明，该位点是识别并与DNA形成相互作用的稳定部分。此外，预测了六个靶基因，其上游具有由TraesCS2B02G002700调控的CCGAC基序。我们的研究为探索植物中的转录因子及识别例如潜在的盐胁迫靶基因提供了一个总体框架。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
